title: Find mail servers for a domain using nslookup
summary: Use nslookup to find the mail servers (MX records) responsible for receiving email for a domain. This is useful for checking email configuration.

steps.explain: Query for the mail server (MX record) of the domain, showing details of the transaction.

placeholders.name: DOMAIN
placeholders.description: The domain name to look up

steps.expect: The command outputs the MX records for the domain, listing the mail servers and their priorities.

alternatives.explain: Query the DNS resolver for the MX (Mail Exchange) record of the specified domain.

placeholders.name: DOMAIN
placeholders.description: The domain name to query for MX records.
